title: Normalization and smooth constant case
statement:
For a reduced curve, extension-invariance for $j_!\underline{\mathbf F_\ell}$
reduces through the finite normalization to the corresponding calculation on
a smooth curve, both for proper and affine opens and also when
$\ell=\operatorname{char}k$.

proof.text: Obtain the normalization monomorphism, its constructible cokernel and vanishing over V from exists_mono_lowerShriek_constantModSheaf_lowerStar. The source calculations are already the hypothesis H in this Lean interface.
Use finite_pushforward_open_constantModSheaf_constructible for the direct-image sheaf G, then of_finite_pushforward_module to obtain its eight assertions from H.

Prove that the constant quotient sheaf is annihilated by ℓ using Ideal.Quotient.eq_zero_iff_mem. Additivity of extension by zero and direct image gives ℓ • id G = 0. Apply of_finite_support_mono to the normalization monomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Lemmas 0A5D, 0A3Q and 0GJA; explicit module-valued normalization reduction by B3
